descripcion: Voz que abre y cierra; en medio, el espacio habla solo.
escena: An empty study at dusk. A warm brass desk lamp glows on a heavy wooden table with an open book, tall shelves of worn hardbacks rising into darkness, a tall window showing deep blue evening sky.
ambiente: A quiet room tone with the faint hum of a distant street beyond the window, and the soft creak of old wood.
musica: A sparse low sustained cello note held quietly, restrained and continuous, unchanging in character.
apoyos: Dust motes drift slowly through the lamp beam. Nothing else moves.
Extreme close-up of the open book, the page edges catching the warm light.
The light on the shelves shifts almost imperceptibly. The room is empty.
Extreme close-up of the brass lamp base, the metal scratched and warm.
notas: La categoria mas exigente: la imagen sostiene la pieza casi sola. Sirve para medir si el modelo da para CONTAR o solo para ilustrar a alguien hablando.
